snippet.title: Aeon Guard - Nex Playground Trailer
snippet.description:
Rise as the cosmos’ chosen defender, harnessing its power to stand against the galaxy’s darkest threats.

Aeon Guard is a motion-controlled power-casting game exclusively for the Nex Playground. Players defend against waves of enemies by tracing patterns to unleash a celestial arsenal of powers.

https://www.nexplayground.com/games
